title: CodeIntentBench rule
description: One recorded project rule. The neutral source every arm renders from.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, unique within the project.

statement.description: The rule in one or two plain sentences, as a product owner would write it.

rationale.description: Why the rule exists. Rendered to arms; never mentions the benchmark.

scope.description: Where the rule applies, so arms that link rules to code can do so.

tests.description: Hidden rule-test ids that encode this rule. Never shown to the agent.
